panels.description: Colorado logistics terminal. Roman submits an Antarctic transport request. The terminal visibly separates Falcon field site from Nexus coastal cave laboratory and identifies the Antarctic over-ice leg as two hours, weather dependent. Leave upper-left for location caption and center for route captions.
Roman signs the existing CSG logistics authorization. His bonded TJ waits beside him. Leave upper-right for Roman's dialogue and upper-left for the authorization caption.

Roman boards a conventional long-range aircraft or sealed passenger-cargo connection with his bonded TJ secured in a padded case. No Antarctic tracked vehicle appears here. Leave the top for a transfer caption.
A route schematic shows Colorado to an Antarctic logistics hub, then separate over-ice lines to Falcon and Nexus, converging only at Nexus. Leave upper-left for the route caption.
